newsitem.title: USA: ZMAX says Atlas suit settled, dismissed.
newsitem.headline: ZMAX says Atlas suit settled, dismissed.

text.p: A lawsuit against a ZMAX Corp shareholder has been settled and dismissed by a Canadian court, which also lifted its earlier order prohibiting transfer of 2.8 million shares of ZMAX issued in September 1996, ZMAX said on Friday.

Atlas Capital Group filed finder's fee litigation against ZMAX shareholder and consultant Shafiq Nazerali in the Supreme Court of British Columbia, Canada. The suit was settled and dismissed with prejudice, ZMAX said.

ZMAX said the court permanently rescinded its previous order prohibiting the transfer, disposition, encumbrance or any other dealing with any of the 2.8 million shares of ZMAX issued in September 1996. ZMAX said it paid nothing in the settlement.

In a previous announcement, ZMAX said it had been named, along with certain investors, in the suit, which alleged that ZMAX entered into a partnership agreement with Nazerali that entitled it to an equity interest or compensation from him in connection with ZMAX's acquisition of Century Services Inc last year.
